back: The route along which a message passes between sender and receiver.
Vertical flows up and down the hierarchy; horizontal flows between people or departments at the same level.
One-way has no planned feedback; two-way includes a reply so understanding can be checked.
Informal communication between people outside the official channels: fast, but it can carry rumour.
Language and jargon, noise, distance, overload, technology failure, attitudes and mistrust, culture and status, poor timing.
Messages are slow and may be filtered or distorted at each level.
Choose a suitable method, use plain language, seek feedback, shorten the chain, train staff and build trust.
It cannot be banned; give accurate, timely information so that rumours have less room.
Higher efficiency and morale against cost and management time; judge for the size and problem of the business.
